about.title: About
about.p1: Saiful Abidin is a Full Stack Developer and Software Engineer based in Wonogiri, Central Java, Indonesia. Currently engineering core enterprise platforms at PT. Infinity Blessing Indonesia, managing real-time systems and scalable business pipelines.
about.p2: My trajectory began through disciplined, intensive self-direction. Over the past 5+ years, that foundation has evolved into robust competency across the entire engineering lifecycle, including frontend architecture, resilient backend APIs, relational database design, and cross-platform mobile development with Flutter.
